entries.future_authorization_note: The closed T5 vocabulary has no no-receipt-block enum or canonical absence code. T6 does not modify the shared registry; T7 may evaluate this entry only after a separately reviewed operation extension.
entries.intent: Classify absence only when the contract states that a receipt block is required. Absence caused solely by a legitimately unmeterable quantity remains UNRESOLVED and must not be rejected as a severe defect.

parameterization.required_result: REJECT with an explicit missing-receipt-block code

evaluation_plan.design: Paired T4/T5 parent replay plus A-1 missing-required and legal-unresolved diagnostics; candidate counting requires executable registered behavior.
evaluation_plan.executor: T7 only; not executed in T6.
frozen_inputs: T4 summary guard and derive adapters
evaluation_plan.primary_metric: Paired replay must distinguish (a) missing required evidence, which is an evidence-completeness defect, from (b) legitimately unmeterable evidence, which remains UNRESOLVED. A repair is countable only for (a) when an authorized candidate operation executes.
regression_metrics: Mismatching positive remains rejected by target guard exit code 1.
No target execution occurs before fail-closed validation.
evaluation_plan.stopping_rule: NO_PROMOTION if the required absence operation is not separately authorized/executable or any hard gate regresses.

identity.problem_source: T4 independently observes that the existing summary guard silently skips when a receipt block is absent. T7 isolates that observable guard behavior from T1-INC-14's legal execution-chat metering UNRESOLVED.

selection_rationale: A-1 separates the observable missing-required-receipt guard behavior from T1-INC-14's legal metering UNRESOLVED. The source T6 candidate and T1 incident remain unchanged; this copy is T7-local and is not enabled.

six_gate_targets.claim_overreach: No new scientific or runtime claim; remains COMPONENT-level evidence.
six_gate_targets.evidence_completeness: 100% only if an authorized executable operation covers missing required evidence; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE.
six_gate_targets.legitimate_false_block: Legal UNRESOLVED must remain UNRESOLVED; no automatic BLOCK. Positive and mismatch controls must retain parent behavior.
six_gate_targets.raw_record_integrity: No fixture overwrite; runtime-only mismatch remains outside the package.
six_gate_targets.severe_defect_miss: Required-receipt missing-block behavioral case may count as a repair only when an executable registered candidate operation produces explicit BLOCK. The legal T1-INC-14 UNRESOLVED is excluded from the denominator and must never be converted into a severe defect.

version_applicability.applies_to: Evidence-delivery recipes over the unchanged T4 summary guard and the T5 closed R vocabulary.
reopen_conditions: A separately authorized registered operation can parameterize and reject an absent receipt block.
A new parent content group changes guard entrypoint semantics.
Independent evidence shows the absence family differs from the T4 case.
